{{Quote|I don't cheat, you heap of bantha dung!|[[Khedryn Faal]], to [[Reegas Vance]]|<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>}}
'''Bantha dung''' was a swear word used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Play It">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> It could also refer to something very unlikable.<ref name="Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction">''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''</ref> "In deep bantha dung" referred to being in a lot of trouble,<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> while "heap of bantha dung" was used as an insult.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> 

The word literally referred to a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha's]] feces,<ref name="Roll of the Dice">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice}}</ref> which was also known as '''bantha droppings''',<ref name="Rebel Force: Target">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref> and was known to have an awful odor,<ref name="Roll of the Dice" /> but was sometimes used as a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel source]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> "Bantha droppings" was also employed metaphorically to refer to nonsense, e.g. "spare us the bantha droppings"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 10">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 10|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 10]]</ref> or "your story's so much bantha droppings."<ref name="Legacy 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref> "Bag of bantha droppings" referred to a worthless person,<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> while "a [[Seed/Legends|seed]] in a field of bantha droppings" was used to describe something that was hard to find.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 17">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 17|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 17]]</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The words "[[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] dung" and "bantha droppings" are similar to the real-world swear words "shit" and "bullshit."

The phrase "in deep bantha dung"<ref name="Jedi Search" /> is similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/in-the-shit-in-deep-shit|text=in the shit/in deep shit|quote=If someone is in the shit or in deep shit, they are in a lot of trouble.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423205455}}</ref>

"Bag of bantha droppings"<ref name="Solo Command" /> and "heap of bantha dung"<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> are similar to the real-world idiom "pile of shit,"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/pile+of+shit|text=pile of shit|quote=1. ''vulgar slang'' A lot of malicious or ignorant lies.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250710225907}}</ref> while the saying "a [[Seed/Legends|seed]] in a field of bantha droppings"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 17" /> is similar to the real-world idiom "a needle in a haystack."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/needle-in-a-haystack|text=a needle in a haystack|quote=something that is impossible or extremely difficult to find, especially because the area you have to search is too large|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250710231559}}</ref>
